title: Chick Chambers and Sugar Johnny
summary: Richie asks about Chambers and Sugar Johnny; Bocage recalls both moved to Chicago.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Well, do you remember a trumpet player, or a corner player called Joe Johnson, do you know? No, I don't remember a trumpet player. Or Chick Chambers, or?
Chick Chambers, yes. I remember him, yes.
What sort of trumpet player was he? He was all right. He was a head man to him. Sugar Johnny, was he the same?
Sugar Johnny, yes. Yes, I remember him too. He died in Chicago too. I don't remember if Chick's living up there yet, but he was up there. He gave up when he went up there.
Yeah. Yeah, he played around there quite a bit.
He went up Chicago around 19, 18 or 15, around then. Tell me he had a red bean place up there selling food, you know.
